tasks.prompt:
Which of the following is the chemical symbol for gold?

Choices:
(A) Au
(B) Ag
(C) Al
(D) Fe
(E) Hg
(F) Cu
(G) Pb
(H) Zn
(I) Sn
(J) Pt

Return only the letter of the correct choice (A-J).

What is the capital city of France?

Choices:
(A) London
(B) Berlin
(C) Madrid
(D) Rome
(E) Paris
(F) Vienna
(G) Lisbon
(H) Brussels
(I) Amsterdam
(J) Bern

Return only the letter of the correct choice (A-J).
